name: llmproxy
description: Standalone GitHub Copilot proxy CLI with native service management

0.2.60: embed current release notes in the installed package for first-update compatibility
keep deriving update changelogs from the release commit message when available
preserve hardcoded release notes only as a backward-compatible final fallback
0.2.61: stabilize launchd service restart by avoiding explicit stop before kickstart on macOS
treat missing launchd bootout targets as already stopped during service recovery
cap forwarded Copilot tools to 128 on both /responses and /chat/completions
make claude:setup and model:set target the installed llmproxy service port when LLMPROXY_HOME is set
0.2.62: add explicit vision capability for providers with --vision flag in provider:add and provider:key
implement automatic fallback skip for non-vision providers when requests contain images
add provider:test command to verify vision capability of all configured providers
add reasoning_content support for Kimi and other thinking models
add qwen3.7-plus, deepseek-v4-pro, kimi-k2.6 to model-capabilities registry
0.2.63: support multiple instances of the same provider with different models via provider:add
fix update-service.sh: use docker-compose.production.yml and set LLMPROXY_HOME when missing
fix update-service.sh: graceful skip when Docker Compose is not installed
0.2.65: fix llmproxy test: accept metadata-only provider responses when request_summary confirms success
stabilize provider test fallback handling for delayed request_summary writes
0.2.66: fix self-update: resolve the installed CLI even when the global wrapper path is stale or missing
recreate the global llmproxy entrypoint after update so the shell command remains available immediately
ensure self-update preserves the currently hashed llmproxy path by rewriting it with sudo when necessary
0.2.68: fix self-update: always prefer the freshly installed package CLI over stale wrappers discovered in PATH
recreate the global llmproxy wrapper automatically when it is missing after update
protect the valid global wrapper from cleanup so llmproxy update cannot remove its own entrypoint
0.2.69: document in CLAUDE.md that every commit and push must include an llmproxy version bump first
0.2.70: fix self-update: recreate legacy wrappers such as /usr/bin/llmproxy after update
preserve standard wrapper paths during update cleanup to avoid removing the active command
0.2.71: fix self-update with nvm: preserve the caller's original npm global bin path before switching Node versions
recreate llmproxy in the original npm prefix so the command remains available in the user's active shell
0.2.72: feat: auto-escalation to better providers on repeated requests
add EscalationTracker — detects when the same user message is resent N times
automatically escalates to the next provider after threshold identical messages (LLMPROXY_AUTO_ESCALATE=1)
0.2.73: fix self-update: make generated wrappers point directly to the installed package CLI instead of another global wrapper
fix nvm update path so llmproxy remains callable after upgrading from an older user-global install
0.2.74: test: add 12 unit tests for EscalationTracker auto-escalation module
cover disabled/enabled modes, threshold escalation, multi-level, conversation isolation, cleanup, and eviction
0.3.01: strengthen self-update with automatic backup, post-update smoke test, and rollback on verification failure
verify the freshly installed CLI with version, config:list, and status before declaring success
restore the previously installed global package and restart the managed service automatically when the new build does not pass validation
0.3.02: fix Linux installers so user-local npm prefixes are installed and persisted correctly without stale wrapper resolution
make llmproxy test print the provider HTTP error details for failed quick inference probes
add regression coverage for installer PATH persistence and quick test HTTP error reporting
0.3.03: fix llmproxy update so GitHub CLI is no longer required as a prerequisite
allow self-update on lean Linux servers that only have git and npm installed
keep update preflight focused on real requirements used by the updater
0.3.04: migrate managed project and service configuration automatically during self-update
remove legacy config variables such as LLM_STATS_API_KEY, SENDGRID_*, LLMPROXY_SMART_*, LLMPROXY_METERING_SINK, and split MongoDB keys
reap port 7045 before restart both in self-update and in the one-line installer to avoid stale runtime conflicts
0.3.05: fix llmproxy update and uninstall so the CLI bypasses the local REST wrapper and runs directly in the invoking shell
avoid self-update deadlocks when a managed llmProxy service is already running on the same machine
keep automatic config migration and port-7045 cleanup from 0.3.04 intact
0.3.06: migrate legacy Claude settings from both the current project and the global ~/.claude/settings.json during config migration and self-update
run config migration even when update is launched outside a project directory
remove stale LLMPROXY_SMART_* and legacy key aliases from real on-disk Claude settings, not only from the effective runtime view
0.3.07: add a timeout to the remote package version probe used by llmproxy update
prevent llmproxy update from appearing stuck before installation when the latest-version check hangs on a slow or broken network
keep the global/project Claude settings migration introduced in 0.3.06
0.3.08: make llmproxy test fail when LLMPROXY_LLM_STATS_API_KEY is missing from both project and global Claude settings
align the quick provider test with the real Claude Code inference gate for the mandatory llm-stats key
keep provider health probing intact while preventing false positive 'ok' results for inference-ready validation
0.3.09: fix self-update and persistent install on Unix so they repair and preserve both llmproxy and llmp wrappers
remove stale llmp aliases during uninstall to avoid shadowing an updated global installation
prevent old user-local llmp shims from surviving updates and masking the system-wide CLI on Linux servers
0.3.10: make project-scoped config values inherit from the user's global ~/.claude/settings.json when local overrides are absent
show the effective project values together with a dedicated Global Claude configuration section in config:list
keep service configuration separate from Claude user defaults while making global fallbacks visible and testable
0.3.11: harden request logging so unwritable JSONL files no longer crash /v1/messages and provider tests
repair LLMPROXY_HOME ownership and writable runtime files automatically during persistent install and self-update
prevent legacy sudo-based upgrades from leaving root-owned runtime logs that break subsequent native service requests
